rules.boundary: Root alone edits canonical decisions, ledger, receipts, metadata, source mirrors, hashes, stamps, preparation, gates, state or control. This plan merely links existing evidence/obligations and legal row shapes; no independent mathematical audit or disposition override.

decision_schema.gate: Only supplemental gate:DEFECT_ID, route gate, current subject inside that group, exactly that single ledger ID; ordinary finding verdicts. Do not mint a fake original finding or add source to historical touched scope.
decision_schema.common: id and route must match owed target. Preserve exact original consumer_id/producer_batch/downstream owner_batch and historical flags; repair_confidence1 must be backed by actual same-owner science. Exact subject seals/stamping are Root-only.

rules.carrier_verdict_rules: accepted_repair=current post exactly except the specific permitted risk_review-only addition. amended_repair must differ both native pre and post carriers. Raw-item equality to post is insufficient because carrier also includes contract+manifest. reviewed_no_defect only metadata/audit_enrichment with emptydefect_ids or explicitly authorized current_content_review+unknownhistory; it cannot close actual findings. A repaired finding requires its current carrier differ from frozen observed_sha256. No source/observed hash rewrites to create this difference.

ledger_schema.catcher: Preserve actual reader/refuter/Alpha original catcher; new Root-discovered actual defect uses owner/orchestrator truthfully. Do not claim a new native run.
ledger_schema.evidence: Nonempty evidence entries need path or absolute source URL; add bounded actual repair/current-use report refs. repair_confidence1 on fixed repair rows. adjudication_ref must retain each exact decision path+obligation; existing some legacy refs use file instead of path—preserve history, use path on new/corrected refs.
ledger_schema.single_subject: Each row subject must equal decision subject except exact existing added-item causal allowance. Remove foreign supplier row from a touched consumer decision; keep supplier row on actual supplier observation.
ledger_schema.append_history: Archive original rows/decisions once if Root needs correction. Prefer an append-only successor supersedes exact prior same-run/same-subject row when disposition/taxonomy changes; preserve all old refs and genuine science history. Never supersede different subjects or count two lanes as separate defects. No canonical row generated here.
ledger_schema.closed_fatal: confirmed_fatal requires fatal and fixed/narrowed/dropped; confirmed_nonfatal requires nonfatal/polish and fixed/narrowed/dropped/nonfatal-recorded. Use fixed for the actual sound repairs cited here; no narrowing permission inferred.

rules.ordinary_stale_outside_repair: A genuine later producer repair may support a true original outside finding being confirmed and its ledger defect fixed on current source; retain old observation, explicit old unbound limits and actual producer receipt/report as evidence. This is Root current adjudication, not rewriting worker report, new native review or false-positive detection.
sharing_constraints: One actual defect one row; every original obligation retained. sharedFinding requires same subject, both reader/flagged, same final verdict, and same defect plus same severity/location OR exact observed-carrier equality (or exact approved alias). same_defect_as must point to the first encountered compatible decision and have real evidence. It can share same-source four reader57 findings without erasing consumer IDs.

sharedPostReaderRepair only exact same-batch touched/page producer plus its genuine refuter observation of post carrier; accepted/amended touched repair and refuter confirmedfatal/nonfatal. Explicit same_defect_as evidence>=40. Useful21 own touched/refuter pair or50 consumer if the exact post fingerprint holds; no broad foreign-subject exception.

step3-owner-same-defect-aliases requires exact supported kind and hash-bound original scope/native source evidence; not an arbitrary Root override. Pair50:2 differs observed carrier/location;57reader/refuter differ raw historical source too. Do not assume the same-source-distinct-carrier alias applies to different raw source. Classifier aliases remain original labels, not finding rewrites.

cross-group-shared-causal-repair receipt applies only exact same subject, fatal fixed canonical row with confidence1, two original rows superseded, actual producer touched accepted/amended repair, exactly two consumer aliases reader+flagged, frozen scopes/reports/native prepost/all original observations, exact decision-core bindings/current supplier carrier and>=2final scientific evidence. It cannot merge native44/61 producer flagged-only obligations, five57aliases, or unlike subjects. Existing special fluid readiness exception is foreignrun and unavailable.

If Root scientifically establishes same actual defect but no existing guarded sharing kind matches, do not duplicate counts, rewrite findings, invent native touched coverage or silently generalize the helper. Record exact mapping as unresolved in adoption review; it is not cured by stamps. Existing original outside rows may be closed truthfully on their own repair evidence, but that alone does not authorize superseding/reusing incompatible native producer IDs.

rules.supplemental_gate_when_needed: An already owed exact-subject scientific repair should be resolved through its original obligation, not a duplicate gate. Add gate:ID only for a genuine distinct Root-discovered corrective defect on an owning-group subject lacking an adequate owed repair row (or an otherwise unowned actual row). A supplier corrected through outside original finding need not get duplicate nativeproducer credit. A new local helper needs its real auditor-created origin/certification route and actual risk/proof contract, not a gate masquerading as native authoring.
rules.additional_existing_obligations_to_revis: Root source/declaration changes may stale successful non-escalated decisions outside48. Bundle repairs touch own touched19,31,47 postulates plus21 and supplier2 carried in5; super-Poincare changes have existing reader/refuter30 and touched1representation duties. Respect supplied sourceapplication science, update actual metadata/contracts, then Root chooses legal current repair labels and restamps. Local equal-completions example64 has no existing owed finding/touched obligation: use actual local supplier-use review and audit metadata; add supplemental gate only for a genuine discovered defect with ledger row, never just to manufacture coverage. New454lemma ordinary auditor-created origin/certification remains owed.
rules.remaining_root_checks: Bind actual current declarations/source/contract literal quotes and mandatory risk rows after Root159-quote reconciliation. Verify precise existing receipt/alias applicability and subject ownership first, then record bounded current decisions/ledger; Root rehash/stamp/prepares once at actual stopped/drained boundary and runs ordinary scoped gates only after all scientific escalations are resolved. This plan does not execute checks or infer their success.
